notes.title: Meow Mission Patch Note #4
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*][b]Coupon Input Relocation:[/b] Removed the "Enter Coupon" tab from Settings and moved the coupon input field above the "Exit Game" option.
[/list]

notes.title: Meow Mission Patch Note #3
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list][*][b]Linux Support:[/b] Meow Mission is now available on Linux! If you encounter any bugs or issues, please let us know via the Steam discussions board. This is our first release for Linux, so your feedback is invaluable.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*][b]Achievement Completion Issue:[/b] Fixed a bug where certain achievements wouldn’t unlock properly.
[*][b]P Button Spam Bug:[/b] Resolved an issue where spamming the P button on the start screen caused unexpected behavior.
[*][b]Bonus Layer Arrow Bug:[/b] Corrected an issue where the arrow moved incorrectly when selecting a bonus layer in level selection.

notes.title: macOS Version Patch Complete
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Accelix.
The patch to fix the macOS version issue has been successfully completed. You can now enjoy the game without any problems!

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused and deeply appreciate your patience and support. We will continue to work hard to provide a stable gaming experience for all players.

Thank you,
Sincerely Accelix.

notes.title: macOS Patch in Progress
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Accelix.

We are currently working on an urgent patch to address issues with the macOS version of the game. As a result, the game may be temporarily unavailable on macOS.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Please rest assured that we are doing our best to resolve the issue as quickly as possible and restore a stable gaming experience.

We will update you as soon as the patch is complete.
Thank you for your understanding and patience.

Sincerely,
Accelix.

notes.title: Meow Mission Patch Note #2

notes.title: Demo Patch Note #1
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers! 

First, we would like to thank everyone who has played the [b]Meow Mission[/b] demo build. 
For those who haven't tried the demo yet, we hope this patch note will be a great opportunity to check it out!

[h3]Patch Note[/h3] 
[b]New Features[/b] 
[olist] 
[*][b]Controller Support[/b]: Xbox and PlayStation controllers are now supported. 
[*][b]Windowed/Full-Screen Toggle[/b] feature has been added. 
[*][b]Demo Missions Added[/b][/olist] [list] 
[*] Main Mission: Playable up to Mission 33 
[*] Bonus Mission: Playable up to Mission B4 [/list]

[b]Changes[/b] 
[list] [*] UI size adjustments for a more comfortable display 
[*] Various bug fixes for enhanced stability [/list]

The [b]Meow Mission[/b] demo is free for anyone to download!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3293510/Meow_Mission_Demo/

Check out the new features and missions in the demo, and if you enjoyed it, please support us by adding it to your [b]wishlist[/b]!

Happy gaming! 😊
